name: wsrv/client
description: PHP client for the wsrvd WebSocket sidecar (IPC protocol v0) and an embedded server over FFI. Works on every PHP stack; the sidecar client is pure PHP.

suggest.ext-ffi: Needed only for the embedded server, Wsrv\Embedded\Server (PHP CLI); the sidecar client does not use it
suggest.ext-pcntl: Needed only for signal handling in worker scripts (see the echo example in bindings/php/examples)
